A [[Human/Legends|Human]] was the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] '''partner''' of another being, [[Tham]]. In [[138 ABY]], Tham had an idea to make more profit and the pair brought their recent haul to [[Ania Solo]]'s [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junkyard]]. Tham's [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] partner asked for ten thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for their shipment but Solo stood firm in her offer of two hundred. The scavengers then threatened to take whatever valuables Solo had in her junkyard but were surprised from behind by [[SD]], Solo's droid. In the end, Tham and the bearded Human were escorted back to their [[Tham's ship|ship]] and forced to leave their shipment behind without receiving any payment.<ref name="Legacy 1" />
